caption: The video captures a broad natural waterfall viewed from a cliff-top vantage, where a wide, turbulent sheet of white water pours continuously over a rock lip into a deep gorge. A calm grey river approaches the brink at the upper left, its dark surface marked by steady forward streaks of foam advancing toward the edge. Dense green trees and shrubs crown the cliff edge, while a band of leafy vegetation sits across the bottom foreground. To the right, a separate, taller vertical fall drops into a canyon filled with rising white mist that billows and shifts shape throughout. The main white-water sheet churns without pause, foam crests and streaks deforming and translating downward over the lip. The framing drifts gradually, the far-left tree mass sliding out of view, the left river opening widening, and the right-hand fall shifting leftward across the scene, consistent with a slow camera pan. The bottom of the gorge and where the falling water lands remain out of sight.
